in_hebrew.name: Charlton
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Free man's town
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Charlton הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English 'Carl', meaning 'free man'. The suffix 'ton' denotes a town or settlement. In Latin, it is translated as 'Carlus' and in Greek as 'Karlos'. Historically, Charlton has been used as a surname and as a given name.
